What we do

Everything with wheels. Or almost.

Whether it is a breakdown at midnight, a classic car that needs treating carefully, or a dealer move involving three vehicles at once, CW sorts it.

24/7 Vehicle Recovery

Broken down across Newcastle, Gateshead, Sunderland or anywhere in the North East. Fast response, any hour, any vehicle type. From £50 local.

Single vehicles or multiple. Auction collections, private buys, dealer stock moves, non-runners. Local and nationwide, loaded right and delivered on time.

Who you are calling

Callum.
One number, gets it done.

CW Vehicle Transport and Recovery is run by Callum, based in Gateshead and out on the road across the North East every day. You speak to him directly when you call, he loads your vehicle himself, and he drives it to where it needs to go.

No call centres. No sending someone else. Just one reliable person who treats every vehicle, whether it is a daily runner or a classic worth serious money, with the same level of care.

From a £50 local recovery to a multi-vehicle transporter run across the country, the same friendly, professional and fairly priced service every time. That is why people keep coming back and keep recommending him.
